game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing, a woodcutter's clearing: the forest ranger must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing: a woodcutter's clearing
core_gameplay_loop: In Woodcutter Clearing, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round, a new moss bundles challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 380 points of moss bundles by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 380, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Loop Picker
